component.name: Codinian
component.summary: Run and supervise Claude Agent SDK sessions

description.p: Codinian starts and supervises your own local Claude Code sessions through the Claude Agent SDK, and puts a window around them: a sidebar of running sessions, a transcript pane, tool-call approvals, and the project's git state and issue tracker beside them.

The same sessions are reachable from a phone or a second machine over a loopback-bound HTTP server, which is intended to be published on a tailnet rather than on a LAN. Approving a tool call runs that tool on the machine Codinian is running on, so the server binds to localhost by default and a token is required for every request.
Authentication is whatever the claude CLI already uses on the machine. Codinian does not proxy, store or forward Anthropic credentials and adds no account of its own.
